name: personal_site
description: A modern PHP CRUD application for managing your music collection with database integration, search functionality, autocomplete features, and external API integration.

scripts.build: npm run build:sass && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/app.js -o assets/js/app.min.js --compress --mangle && terser assets/js/demo.js -o assets/js/demo.min.js --compress --mangle
scripts.vendor:barcode: mkdir -p assets/js/barcode-scanner && cp node_modules/@undecaf/zbar-wasm/dist/main.js assets/js/barcode-scanner/zbar-wasm-main.js && cp node_modules/@undecaf/zbar-wasm/dist/zbar.wasm assets/js/barcode-scanner/zbar.wasm && cp node_modules/@undecaf/barcode-detector-polyfill/dist/main.js assets/js/barcode-scanner/barcode-detector-polyfill-main.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='assets/js/barcode-scanner/barcode-detector-polyfill-main.js';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/https:\\/\\/cdn\\.jsdelivr\\.net\\/npm\\/@undecaf\\/zbar-wasm@[^/]+\\/dist\\/main\\.js/,'./zbar-wasm-main.js');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);"
scripts.watch: npm run watch:sass & npm run watch:js
scripts.build:sass: sass assets/scss:assets/css --style=compressed && sass assets/scss/critical.scss assets/css/critical.css --style=compressed && sass assets/scss/critical-dark.scss assets/css/critical-dark.css --style=compressed
scripts.watch:sass: sass assets/scss:assets/css --watch --style=compressed & sass assets/scss/critical.scss assets/css/critical.css --watch --style=compressed & sass assets/scss/critical-dark.scss assets/css/critical-dark.css --watch --style=compressed
